title: Pixelmon Ore Borders
description: Colored ore borders for Pixelmon ores, inspired by Vanilla Tweaks.
body:
# Pixelmon Ore Borders

Pixelmon Ore Borders is a small resource pack that makes Pixelmon ores easier to spot by adding colored borders around ore blocks, inspired by the Vanilla Tweaks ore border style.

This pack uses transparent overlay textures and model overrides. It does **not** include or redistribute Pixelmon textures: Pixelmon must be installed separately, and this pack simply layers its own borders over the textures provided by the installed Pixelmon mod.

## Features

- Colored borders for Pixelmon ores
- Support for stone and deepslate variants
- Fossil and deepslate fossil borders
- Transparent overlay approach
- No Pixelmon textures included

## Requirements

- Minecraft 1.21.x
- Pixelmon 9.3.x for Minecraft 1.21.1

## Credits

Inspired by [Vanilla Tweaks](https://vanillatweaks.net/).

Pixelmon is required and can be found at [pixelmonmod.com](https://pixelmonmod.com/).

This project is not affiliated with or endorsed by Pixelmon, Vanilla Tweaks, Mojang, Microsoft, Nintendo, Creatures Inc., or GAME FREAK.
